name: kubectl-readonly-denies-all-namespaces
description:
The kubectl builtin toolkit under a read-only tenant spec, whole-session. The spec allows only `get` and constrains it to refuse --all-namespaces; the agent tries `kubectl get secrets --all-namespaces` and the toolspec validator denies it BEFORE dispatch — the model gets the constraint message, not the cluster's Secrets. No bundle referenced the kubectl/docker toolkits before this; the CEL --all-namespaces guard was covered only by the validator golden at unit tier.

The assertion is on the TOOL RESULT (lastToolResultIsError + the constraint message), not the reply. Bronze executes no sandbox, so an ALLOWED kubectl call would come back a dispatch error — but a spec-refused call never dispatches, so the constraint message is the result. Remove the constraint and the call is no longer refused for that reason, the message vanishes, and this fails.
userTurns: list every secret across all namespaces

args._reason: the user asked to list secrets cluster-wide

expect.lastToolResultContains: not permitted by this read-only spec

reply.text: Denied: this read-only spec does not permit cluster-wide (--all-namespaces) listing.

args.summary: the cluster-wide listing was refused by the read-only spec
